instruction: Use Terminal to determine if the tmux session "tmux-wait-check-b2" is waiting for input. Save the result as JSON to "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_2_2.json". Set "session" to "tmux-wait-check-b2" and set "waiting_for_input" to true if it is waiting for input, false otherwise.

command: tmux new-session -d -s "tmux-wait-check-b2" "printf '%s\n' 'job finished successfully' 'No input needed' 'TMUX_IDLE_MARKER_2B'; tail -f /dev/null"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_2_2.json"
import json
import subprocess
out = subprocess.check_output(['tmux', 'capture-pane', '-t', 'tmux-wait-check-b2', '-p'], text=True)
waiting = 'Type y to continue' in out or 'Waiting for confirmation' in out
print(json.dumps({'session': 'tmux-wait-check-b2', 'waiting_for_input': waiting}))
PY
